user_persona: An agent that runs host.note.put {text, attach_to: {tool}} once and reads the note on that tool's description in every later session; the same user's second client sees it too.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given an `oauth_issuers` row with issuer `toolconf-probe` inserted directly into the test database, When the root and per-tenant documents are built, Then neither lists it and `host.doctor` reports one invalid row with that id and reason `not_https_url`.

Given the validator's rejection table, When the generated test feeds each case to the write verb and to the read filter, Then both reject the same set and the test fails on the first divergence, naming the case.

Given a tenant with two valid issuers, When `host.oauth.issuer_remove` names one, Then the row is gone, the per-tenant and root documents no longer list it, an audit row exists, and the response is `{removed: true}`.

Given an admin and a tenant's invalid issuer, When `admin.oauth.issuer_remove` runs with a reason, Then the row is removed, the audit row carries the reason, and the tenant's own documents rebuild without it.
Given a disabled tenant and an orphan row whose tenant id no longer exists, When the root document is built, Then neither row is listed and the doctor reports the orphan with reason `tenant_missing`.
Given two concurrent `issuer_remove` calls for the same issuer, When both complete, Then exactly one returns `{removed: true}`, the other `not_found`, and no panic or duplicate audit row occurs.

Given an empty `oauth_issuers` table, When the root document is built, Then it lists exactly the hosted authorization server and the doctor reports `{rows: 0, invalid: []}`. - iter_log: 2026-10-14T22:45:05Z amended by /dream (build_priority high → normal, carbon controller; Joe 10-14 3:4x pm "prioritize the mcphost PRDs that are blocking synthorg PRDs. have them go next.") — yields the high tier to the 8 synthorg-blocking mcphost PRDs; re-raise when those have landed; frontmatter only
